description: Update a draft email. Use sendAt (ISO 8601 datetime) to schedule or reschedule automatic sending without another tool call. Changes to a scheduled draft affect the content and recipients of the email sent at that time; once it is sending, edits are refused.

bcc.description: Blind-copied addresses, hidden from the other recipients

cc.description: Copied addresses, visible to every recipient

draftId.description: Draft ID, from list_drafts or create_draft

html.description: HTML body for formatted mail; inline images use cid:<contentId>

inboxId.description: Inbox ID: the inbox's email address, from list_inboxes

replyTo.description: Addresses that replies should go to instead of this inbox

sendAt.description: New send time, as ISO 8601 with a timezone (e.g. 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z)

text.description: Plain-text body; include it even with html, since no text version is generated from html

to.description: Recipient addresses, each a bare address or "Name <address>"
